description: This file contains maintenance functions for task flow registry, including pruning, finalizing canceled flows, and summarizing audit findings. It manages task flow lifecycle based on status and timing.

methods.name: isTerminalFlow
methods.description: Checks if a task flow has a terminal status (succeeded, failed, canceled, lost).

methods.name: hasActiveLinkedTasks
methods.description: Determines if a flow has active linked tasks (queued or running).

methods.name: resolveTerminalAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the flow reached a terminal state, prioritizing endedAt, then updatedAt, then createdAt.

methods.name: shouldPruneFlow
methods.description: Decides if a flow should be pruned based on terminal status, active linked tasks, and retention period.

methods.name: shouldFinalizeCancelledFlow
methods.description: Checks if a canceled flow in managed mode can be finalized (marked as canceled).

methods.name: finalizeCancelledFlow
methods.description: Attempts to finalize a canceled flow by updating its status, with retries if needed.
